decisions.reason: Disabling hover animations on mobile does not change the gallery category tabs or optional photography area.
The gallery remains an interactive scrollable gallery; disabling mobile hover effects does not alter its browsing behavior.
Homepage button destinations are an independent requirement addressed by another clause of the message, not a necessary consequence of disabling mobile hover animations.
Mobile pricing-table formatting and horizontal scrolling are independent of the mobile hover-animation setting.
Disabling mobile hover animations does not change the one-time pricing model or pricing-tab visibility.
The service-pricing diagram, transparency, and individual-item selection remain valid without modification.
The homepage hero image emphasis and blue overlay presentation are unrelated to gallery-item hover behavior.
Package count, square-footage ranges, and displayed prices are unaffected by the mobile hover-animation decision.
Representative service imagery remains required and is not changed by disabling hover animations on mobile gallery items.
Removing a mobile interaction effect does not change the site-wide requirement for a highly visual, image-focused presentation.
The source changes a specific mobile hover interaction, not the site's responsive layout across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
